questions.promptEn:
01 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ가 의미하는 것은?
B: Excuse me. I’d like to check out this book.
W: Sure. Can you show your library card to me, please?
B: ⓐHere you go.
W: Thank you. Please return the book by next week.
B: Okay. Thank you.

questions.promptEn:
[09-12] 다음 대화를 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
G: Excuse me. I’m trying to choose a book. ⓐ저를 도와주실 수 있나요?
M: Sure. What kind of book are you looking ⓑ______?
G: Well, I want to read about animals.
M: Okay. Books about animals are on this shelf. What kind of animals are you interested ⓒ______?
G: I’m curious about sea life.
M: Then what ⓓ______ this book, The Blue Planet? It’s ⓔ______ animals in the deep sea.
G: That sounds perfect. Thank you.
M: You’re welcome.
